<!-- wp:html -->
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin><link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:ital,wdth,wght@0,62..125,400..900;1,62..125,400..900&display=swap"><style>
/*
VOICE  noite na zona leste, farol aceso: confiante, direto, de rua
IDEA   o painel do carro: velocímetro, odômetro, faixa de pista; a página se dirige
PICTURE o Onix amarelo da Esplanada em tela cheia, com um velocímetro que crava 89,1
COLOUR preto domina; amarelo #FFD400 é farol e tinta de pista; azul #2AA9E0 só em detalhes
TYPE   Archivo expandida black itálica nos títulos, Archivo no corpo; números tabulares
*/
:root{
  --y:#FFD400; --k:#070707; --k1:#0E0E0E; --k2:#161616; --k3:#202020; --b:#2AA9E0; --w:#F5F2E6; --mut:#A8A390; --line:#ffffff17; --wa:#1FB955;
  --disp:"Archivo","Arial Narrow",sans-serif; --ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;min-width:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:80px;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scrollbar-color:var(--y) var(--k)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--k);color:var(--w);font:400 16.5px/1.6 var(--disp);overflow-x:clip;caret-color:var(--y)}
::selection{background:var(--y);color:var(--k)}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:11px}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--k)}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--y);border:3px solid var(--k);border-radius:8px}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:inherit;text-underline-offset:.22em;text-decoration-thickness:1.5px}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--y);outline-offset:4px;border-radius:6px}
.wrap{width:min(1240px,100% - 40px);margin-inline:auto}
.t{font-family:var(--disp);font-stretch:118%;font-weight:900;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:.95;text-wrap:balance;margin:0}
h2.t{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,46px)}
.sub{color:var(--mut);font-size:clamp(16px,1.15vw,17.5px);max-width:58ch;margin:14px 0 0}
.y{color:var(--y)}
.num{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
section{position:relative}
.sec{padding:clamp(80px,11vw,150px) 0}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;min-height:52px;padding:0 26px;border-radius:999px;font:800 15.5px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:110%;text-decoration:none;border:1.5px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .4s var(--ease),box-shadow .4s var(--ease),background .25s,color .25s,border-color .25s;white-space:nowrap}
.btn svg{width:19px;height:19px;flex:none}
.btn-y{background:var(--y);color:var(--k)}
.btn-y:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 34px -16px #ffd400aa}
.btn-o{border-color:#ffffff40;color:var(--w)}
.btn-o:hover{border-color:var(--y);color:var(--y)}
.btn-wa{background:var(--wa);color:#03210e}
.btn-k{background:var(--k);color:var(--y)}

/* ===== Rota Esplanada ===== */
.rota{background:var(--b)}
.rota-pin{position:relative;padding:clamp(72px,10vw,120px) 0}
.rota-scene,.rota-panel{display:none}
.rota-list{list-style:none;margin:34px auto 0;padding:0 20px;max-width:1240px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:14px}
.rota-list li{background:var(--y);border-radius:16px;padding:20px}
.rota-list h3{font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:120%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 8px}
.rota-list p{margin:0;font-size:15.5px}
.rota.on{height:560vh}
.rota.on .rota-pin{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;overflow:hidden;padding:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7CCDF0 0%,#B9E5F8 60%,#E6F6FD 100%)}
.rota.on .rota-list{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);margin:0;padding:0}
.rota.on .rota-scene{display:block;position:absolute;inset:0 0 var(--dock,0px);--sw:560px;--road:150px}
.rota.on .rota-head{position:relative;z-index:3;padding-top:calc(var(--hdr,76px) + clamp(18px,4vh,40px))}
.rota-head .lead{color:#123}
@media(min-width:821px){.rota.on .rota-head h2,.rota.on .rota-head .lead{max-width:calc(100% - 460px)}.rota.on .rota-head h2{font-size:clamp(32px,3.6vw,52px)}}
.rota-city{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:calc(var(--road) + 26px);height:42%;width:400%;will-change:transform}
.rota-city i{position:absolute;bottom:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8FC4DD 64%,transparent 0) 0 0/14px 100%,linear-gradient(#8FC4DD 60%,transparent 0) 0 8px/100% 18px,#DDF0FA}
.rota-city i:nth-child(3n){background:linear-gradient(90deg,#A9D3E7 66%,transparent 0) 0 0/12px 100%,linear-gradient(#A9D3E7 62%,transparent 0) 0 6px/100% 20px,#EEF8FD}
.rota-world{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:var(--road);height:58%;width:calc(var(--sw) * 7);will-change:transform;z-index:1}
.rota-lamps{position:absolute;inset:0}
.rota-lamps i{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:6px;height:52%;background:#3A3A3A;border-radius:3px}
.rota-lamps i::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:44px;height:6px;background:#3A3A3A;border-radius:3px}
.rota-lamps i::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:4px;left:34px;width:16px;height:8px;background:var(--y);border-radius:0 0 8px 8px}
.rota-sign{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:160px;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;transition:transform .5s var(--ease),filter .5s;filter:saturate(.35) brightness(.92);transform:scale(.9);transform-origin:bottom center}
.rota-dia{position:relative;width:104px;height:104px;margin-bottom:24px;transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--y);border:6px solid var(--k);outline:4px solid var(--y);border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 18px 22px -14px #0007}
.rota-dia svg{width:46px;height:46px;transform:rotate(-45deg);fill:none;stroke:var(--k);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.rota-plate{font:800 14px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:115%;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--k);color:var(--y);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:4px;white-space:nowrap}
.rota-pole{width:8px;flex:1 1 auto;max-height:44%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6c6c6c,#cfcfcf 50%,#5a5a5a)}
.rota-sign.lit{filter:none;transform:scale(1) translateY(-6px)}
.rota-sign.done{filter:saturate(.8);transform:scale(.94)}
.rota-finish{position:absolute;bottom:calc(var(--road) * -.5);height:calc(80% + var(--road) * .5);border-left:10px solid var(--k);border-right:10px solid var(--k);filter:saturate(.4);transition:filter .5s}
.rota-finish span{position:absolute;top:0;left:-10px;right:-10px;height:60px;background:conic-gradient(var(--y) 25%,var(--k) 0 50%,var(--y) 0 75%,var(--k) 0) 0 0/24px 24px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.rota-finish span::after{content:"CNH na mão";font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:120%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--b);color:#fff;padding:6px 16px;border-radius:6px}
.rota-finish.lit{filter:none}
.rota-road{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:var(--road);background:#2E2E2E;z-index:2}
.rota-road::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-12px;height:12px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--y) 0 34px,var(--k) 34px 68px)}
.rota-lane{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;height:7px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--y) 0 64px,transparent 64px 116px);will-change:background-position}
.rota-car{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:clamp(16px,15vw,420px);bottom:calc(var(--road) * .28);width:clamp(190px,21vw,290px)}
.rota-car svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
.rota.moving .rota-car svg{animation:bump .3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes bump{to{transform:translateY(-1.5px)}}
.wheel{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.rota.on .rota-panel{display:block;position:absolute;z-index:6;right:clamp(16px,5vw,80px);top:calc(var(--hdr,76px) + clamp(18px,4vh,40px));width:min(400px,calc(100% - 32px));background:var(--k);color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:0 30px 50px -28px #000c}
.rp-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;color:#D9D4B4}
.rp-top .km{color:var(--y)}
.rp-title{font:900 clamp(26px,2.6vw,36px)/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:125%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin:12px 0 8px;color:var(--y)}
.rp-text{margin:0;font-size:15.5px;min-height:3em}
.rp-bars{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:16px}
.rp-bars i{flex:1;height:6px;border-radius:9px;background:#ffffff26;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.rp-bars i b{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--y);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(0)}
.rp-cta{display:none!important;margin-top:16px}
.rota.end .rp-cta{display:inline-flex!important}
.swap{animation:swap .45s var(--ease)}
@keyframes swap{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);filter:blur(4px)}}
@media(max-width:820px){
  .rota.on{height:520vh}
  .rota.on .rota-scene{--sw:88vw;--road:96px}
  .rota.on .rota-head{padding-top:calc(var(--hdr,64px) + 14px)}
  .rota.on .rota-head h2{font-size:30px}
  .rota.on .rota-head .lead{display:none}
  .rota.on .rota-panel{left:16px;right:16px;width:auto;top:auto;bottom:calc(96px + 30vh + var(--dock,0px));padding:16px 18px}
  .rp-title{font-size:28px}.rp-text{font-size:14.5px;min-height:0}
  .rota.end .rp-text,.rota.end .rp-bars{display:none}
  .rota-world{height:28vh}
  .rota-sign{width:120px}.rota-dia{width:72px;height:72px;margin-bottom:16px}.rota-dia svg{width:32px;height:32px}.rota-plate{font-size:12px;padding:6px 9px}
  .rota-car{left:10px;width:160px;bottom:18px}
  .rota-city{height:26%}
}


/* rota à noite (versão preta) */
.rota{background:var(--k)}
.rota-list li{background:var(--k2);color:var(--w)}
.rota-list h3{color:var(--y)}
.rota.on .rota-pin{background:radial-gradient(90% 60% at 70% 10%,#1c2530 0%,#0b0f14 45%,#070707 100%)}
.rota-head .lead{color:var(--mut)}
.rota-city i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#11161c 64%,transparent 0) 0 0/14px 100%,linear-gradient(#11161c 60%,transparent 0) 0 8px/100% 18px,#3a3010!important;border-top:1px solid #1d2630}
.rota-city i:nth-child(3n){background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0d1117 70%,transparent 0) 0 0/12px 100%,linear-gradient(#0d1117 64%,transparent 0) 0 6px/100% 20px,#2b2a20!important}
.rota-lamps i,.rota-lamps i::before{background:#2a2a2a}
.rota-lamps i::after{box-shadow:0 0 30px 12px #ffd40055}
.rota-road{background:#141414}
.rota-sign{filter:brightness(.45) saturate(.6)}
.rota-sign.lit{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 26px #ffd40066)}
.rota-sign.done{filter:brightness(.7)}
.rota.on .rota-panel{background:#111;border:1px solid #ffffff1f}
.rota-car::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:96%;top:40%;width:min(46vw,560px);height:150px;transform:translateY(-50%);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff6c8aa,#ffd40022 50%,transparent);clip-path:polygon(0 44%,100% 0,100% 100%,0 58%);mix-blend-mode:screen;pointer-events:none}
@media(max-width:820px){.rota-car::after{width:70vw;height:100px}}

.lead{color:var(--mut);font-size:clamp(16px,1.15vw,17.5px);max-width:58ch;margin:14px 0 0}
/* ===== cabeçalho ===== */
.progress{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:3px;z-index:80;pointer-events:none}
.progress i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--y);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(var(--p,0))}
.top{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;z-index:60;background:#070707ee;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.top.solid{background:#070707e6;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom-color:var(--line)}
.top .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;height:78px}
.logo{display:flex;flex:none;text-decoration:none}
.logo svg{height:42px;width:auto}
.nav{display:flex;gap:30px;margin-left:auto;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.nav a{text-decoration:none;color:#E9E5D5;transition:color .2s}
.nav a:hover{color:var(--y)}
.top .btn{min-height:46px;padding:0 20px}
@media(max-width:960px){.nav{display:none}.top .btn{margin-left:auto}}
@media(max-width:520px){.top .wrap{height:66px}.logo svg{height:34px}.top .btn{min-height:42px;padding:0 15px;font-size:14px}}

/* ===== hero: noite na Penha, o carro amarelo aceso ===== */
.hero{position:relative;background:var(--k);color:#fff;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;min-height:100svh;padding-top:78px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.hero-media{position:absolute;inset:0 0 0 auto;width:min(62%,980px);z-index:-1}
.hero-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:62% 55%;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,#000 34%),linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 22%);-webkit-mask-composite:source-in;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,#000 34%),linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 22%);mask-composite:intersect;filter:saturate(1.08) contrast(1.05)}
.hero-dia{position:absolute;right:max(4vw,40px);top:50%;width:min(44vw,640px);aspect-ratio:1;translate:0 -50%;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none}
.hero-dia i{position:absolute;inset:14%;border:2px solid #FFD40055;border-radius:6%;transform:rotate(calc(45deg + var(--spin,0deg)))}
.hero-dia i+i{inset:24%;border-color:#FFD40026}
.hero>.wrap{position:relative;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(32px,6vh,72px) 0 clamp(28px,5vh,56px)}
.hero-copy{max-width:640px}
.status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;background:#ffffff12;border:1px solid #ffffff26;color:#fff;border-radius:99px;padding:7px 15px 7px 11px;margin:0 0 24px}
.status i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#999}
.status.open i{background:#3BE37A;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #3be37a88;animation:pulse 2s infinite}
.status.closed i{background:#FF5A4E}
@keyframes pulse{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px #3be37a00}}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(38px,4.8vw,70px);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-stretch:115%;color:#fff}
.hero h1 .row{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding:.1em 0 .12em;margin:-.1em 0 -.12em}
.hero h1 .row>span{display:inline-block}
.hero h1 .hl{color:var(--y)}
.hero .sub{font-size:clamp(16px,1.25vw,18px);max-width:46ch;margin:22px 0 28px;color:#D8D3BA}
.hero .ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.hero .btn-y{background:var(--y);color:var(--k)}
.hero .btn-y:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 16px 30px -14px #ffd40099}
.plate{position:absolute;right:clamp(16px,6vw,110px);bottom:clamp(120px,24vh,230px);width:200px;background:#fff;color:var(--k);border:3px solid #111;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 40px -20px #000;transform:rotate(-5deg)}
.plate .bar{background:#1B3FA6;color:#fff;font:800 10px/1 var(--disp);letter-spacing:.12em;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:5px 9px}
.plate .bar svg{height:9px;width:auto}
.plate b{display:block;text-align:center;font:900 40px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:85%;letter-spacing:.02em;padding:7px 6px 1px}
.plate small{display:block;text-align:center;font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;padding:0 8px 8px}
.proof{position:relative;border-top:1px solid #ffffff1f;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#0B0B0B,#0b0b0bcc)}
.proof .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 34px;align-items:center;padding:18px 0;flex:none}
.proof span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;color:#E6E1C8}
.proof b{color:var(--y)}
.proof span::before{content:"";width:9px;height:9px;background:var(--y);transform:rotate(45deg);flex:none}
.lane{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-2px;height:3px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--y) 0 36px,transparent 36px 72px);animation:lane 1.6s linear infinite;opacity:.9}
@keyframes lane{to{background-position:-72px 0}}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero{min-height:0}
  .hero-media{position:relative;inset:auto;width:100%;height:52vw;max-height:420px;min-height:240px;z-index:0}
  .hero-media img{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 40%);mask-image:linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 40%);mask-composite:add;-webkit-mask-composite:source-over}
  .hero-dia{display:none}
  .hero>.wrap{padding-top:0;margin-top:-56px;z-index:1}
  .plate{right:16px;top:calc(min(52vw,420px) - 120px);bottom:auto;width:150px}
  .plate b{font-size:30px}
  .proof .wrap{gap:10px 20px}
}
.hero h1.t{font-size:clamp(38px,4.8vw,70px);line-height:.92}
@media(max-width:900px){.hero{padding-top:66px}.hero h1.t{font-size:clamp(32px,9.4vw,44px)}.hero .ctas .btn{flex:1 1 100%}.proof{margin-top:28px}}

/* ===== manifesto que acende com a rolagem ===== */
.mani{padding:clamp(90px,13vw,170px) 0}
.mani .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,.85fr);gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px);align-items:center}
.mani p{font:800 clamp(24px,2.7vw,40px)/1.22 var(--disp);font-stretch:106%;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0}
.mani figure{margin:0;position:relative;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/5;background:var(--k2)}
.mani figure img{width:100%;height:118%;object-fit:cover;object-position:62% 50%;transform:translateY(var(--my,-6%))}
.mani figcaption{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#070707d9;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;font-size:14px;color:#E6E1C8}
.mani figcaption b{color:var(--y);font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:80%}
@media(max-width:860px){.mani .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mani figure{aspect-ratio:4/3.4}}
.mani p span{color:#ffffff24;transition:color .5s}
.mani p span.on{color:var(--w)}
.mani p span.hl.on{color:var(--y)}
.mani .who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:36px;color:var(--mut);font-size:15px}
.mani .who img{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid var(--y)}

/* ===== lei ===== */
.law{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.85fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);gap:clamp(30px,6vw,96px);align-items:start}
.lrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:baseline;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.lrow.h{padding:0 0 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff40;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut)}
.lrow .was{color:#76725F;text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-thickness:1.5px}
.lrow .now{font:900 19px/1.1 var(--disp);font-stretch:112%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--y);text-align:right}
.law .note{margin-top:22px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
@media(max-width:860px){.law{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:560px){.lrow{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;row-gap:4px}.lrow>span:first-child{grid-column:1/-1;font-weight:600}.lrow.h{display:none}}

/* ===== pacotes: bilhetes ===== */
.pk-grid{margin-top:48px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}
.tk{position:relative;background:var(--k2);border-radius:22px;padding:28px 26px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .5s var(--ease),background .3s}
.tk .perf{position:relative;display:block;margin:0 -26px 24px;border-top:2px dashed #ffffff22}
.tk .perf::before,.tk .perf::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:-14px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--k1)}
.tk .perf::before{left:-13px}.tk .perf::after{right:-13px}
.tk:hover{transform:translateY(-6px)}
.tk.hot{background:var(--y);color:var(--k)}
.tk.hot .perf{border-color:#0000002a}

  .cat .pr{text-align:left;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline}.cat .pr b{display:inline;font-size:21px}

/* ===== Rota Esplanada ===== */
.rota{background:var(--b)}
.rota-pin{position:relative;padding:clamp(72px,10vw,120px) 0}
.rota-scene,.rota-panel{display:none}
.rota-list{list-style:none;margin:34px auto 0;padding:0 20px;max-width:1240px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr));gap:14px}
.rota-list li{background:var(--y);border-radius:16px;padding:20px}
.rota-list h3{font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:120%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0 0 8px}
.rota-list p{margin:0;font-size:15.5px}
.rota.on{height:560vh}
.rota.on .rota-pin{position:sticky;top:0;height:100vh;height:100svh;overflow:hidden;padding:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#7CCDF0 0%,#B9E5F8 60%,#E6F6FD 100%)}
.rota.on .rota-list{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);margin:0;padding:0}
.rota.on .rota-scene{display:block;position:absolute;inset:0 0 var(--dock,0px);--sw:560px;--road:150px}
.rota.on .rota-head{position:relative;z-index:3;padding-top:calc(var(--hdr,76px) + clamp(18px,4vh,40px))}
.rota-head .lead{color:#123}
@media(min-width:821px){.rota.on .rota-head h2,.rota.on .rota-head .lead{max-width:calc(100% - 460px)}.rota.on .rota-head h2{font-size:clamp(32px,3.6vw,52px)}}
.rota-city{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:calc(var(--road) + 26px);height:42%;width:400%;will-change:transform}
.rota-city i{position:absolute;bottom:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8FC4DD 64%,transparent 0) 0 0/14px 100%,linear-gradient(#8FC4DD 60%,transparent 0) 0 8px/100% 18px,#DDF0FA}
.rota-city i:nth-child(3n){background:linear-gradient(90deg,#A9D3E7 66%,transparent 0) 0 0/12px 100%,linear-gradient(#A9D3E7 62%,transparent 0) 0 6px/100% 20px,#EEF8FD}
.rota-world{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:var(--road);height:58%;width:calc(var(--sw) * 7);will-change:transform;z-index:1}
.rota-lamps{position:absolute;inset:0}
.rota-lamps i{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:6px;height:52%;background:#3A3A3A;border-radius:3px}
.rota-lamps i::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:44px;height:6px;background:#3A3A3A;border-radius:3px}
.rota-lamps i::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:4px;left:34px;width:16px;height:8px;background:var(--y);border-radius:0 0 8px 8px}
.rota-sign{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:160px;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;transition:transform .5s var(--ease),filter .5s;filter:saturate(.35) brightness(.92);transform:scale(.9);transform-origin:bottom center}
.rota-dia{position:relative;width:104px;height:104px;margin-bottom:24px;transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--y);border:6px solid var(--k);outline:4px solid var(--y);border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 18px 22px -14px #0007}
.rota-dia svg{width:46px;height:46px;transform:rotate(-45deg);fill:none;stroke:var(--k);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.rota-plate{font:800 14px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:115%;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--k);color:var(--y);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:4px;white-space:nowrap}
.rota-pole{width:8px;flex:1 1 auto;max-height:44%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6c6c6c,#cfcfcf 50%,#5a5a5a)}
.rota-sign.lit{filter:none;transform:scale(1) translateY(-6px)}
.rota-sign.done{filter:saturate(.8);transform:scale(.94)}
.rota-finish{position:absolute;bottom:calc(var(--road) * -.5);height:calc(80% + var(--road) * .5);border-left:10px solid var(--k);border-right:10px solid var(--k);filter:saturate(.4);transition:filter .5s}
.rota-finish span{position:absolute;top:0;left:-10px;right:-10px;height:60px;background:conic-gradient(var(--y) 25%,var(--k) 0 50%,var(--y) 0 75%,var(--k) 0) 0 0/24px 24px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.rota-finish span::after{content:"CNH na mão";font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:120%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--b);color:#fff;padding:6px 16px;border-radius:6px}
.rota-finish.lit{filter:none}
.rota-road{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:var(--road);background:#2E2E2E;z-index:2}
.rota-road::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-12px;height:12px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--y) 0 34px,var(--k) 34px 68px)}
.rota-lane{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;height:7px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--y) 0 64px,transparent 64px 116px);will-change:background-position}
.rota-car{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:clamp(16px,15vw,420px);bottom:calc(var(--road) * .28);width:clamp(190px,21vw,290px)}
.rota-car svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
.rota.moving .rota-car svg{animation:bump .3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes bump{to{transform:translateY(-1.5px)}}
.wheel{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.rota.on .rota-panel{display:block;position:absolute;z-index:6;right:clamp(16px,5vw,80px);top:calc(var(--hdr,76px) + clamp(18px,4vh,40px));width:min(400px,calc(100% - 32px));background:var(--k);color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:0 30px 50px -28px #000c}
.rp-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;color:#D9D4B4}
.rp-top .km{color:var(--y)}
.rp-title{font:900 clamp(26px,2.6vw,36px)/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:125%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin:12px 0 8px;color:var(--y)}
.rp-text{margin:0;font-size:15.5px;min-height:3em}
.rp-bars{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:16px}
.rp-bars i{flex:1;height:6px;border-radius:9px;background:#ffffff26;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.rp-bars i b{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--y);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(0)}
.rp-cta{display:none!important;margin-top:16px}
.rota.end .rp-cta{display:inline-flex!important}
.swap{animation:swap .45s var(--ease)}
@keyframes swap{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);filter:blur(4px)}}
@media(max-width:820px){
  .rota.on{height:520vh}
  .rota.on .rota-scene{--sw:88vw;--road:96px}
  .rota.on .rota-head{padding-top:calc(var(--hdr,64px) + 14px)}

  .rota-car{left:10px;width:160px;bottom:18px}
  .rota-city{height:26%}
}


/* rota à noite (versão preta) */
.rota{background:var(--k)}

.hero{position:relative;background:var(--k);color:#fff;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;min-height:100svh;padding-top:78px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}

.hero>.wrap{position:relative;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(32px,6vh,72px) 0 clamp(28px,5vh,56px)}

.hero h1 .row{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding:.1em 0 .12em;margin:-.1em 0 -.12em}

.tk.hot .for{color:#3d3a28}

.tk .per{font-size:14px;margin:6px 0 24px;color:var(--mut)}
.tk.hot .per{color:#3d3a28}
.tk ul{list-style:none;margin:0 0 26px;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px;font-size:15px}
.tk li{display:flex;gap:10px}
.tk li svg{width:17px;height:17px;flex:none;margin-top:4px;fill:none;stroke:var(--y);stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.tk.hot li svg{stroke:var(--k)}
.tk .btn{margin-top:auto;width:100%}
.tk.hot .btn-o{border-color:var(--k);color:var(--k)}
.fine{margin-top:22px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)}
.fine a{color:var(--y)}
.roll{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;height:1.1em;line-height:1.1em;vertical-align:top}

.roll i{font-style:normal;height:1.1em;line-height:1.1em;display:block}

/* ===== categorias ===== */
.cats{margin-top:44px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff40}

.cat::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--y);z-index:-1;transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom;transition:transform .5s var(--ease);border-radius:14px}
.cat:hover{color:var(--k);padding-inline:22px}
.cat:hover::before{transform:scaleY(1)}
.cat .ic{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:16px;border:1.5px solid #ffffff2a;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:border-color .3s}
.cat .ic svg{width:32px;height:32px;fill:none;stroke:var(--y);stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:stroke .3s}

.cat .pr b{display:block;font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:82%;color:var(--w)}
.cat:hover .pr b{color:var(--k)}
.cat .go svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
.cat:hover .go svg{transform:translateX(6px)}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .cat{grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr);row-gap:10px;padding:20px 4px}
  .cat .ic{width:52px;height:52px;grid-row:span 2;align-self:start}.cat .ic svg{width:26px;height:26px}
  .cat .pr{text-align:left;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline}.cat .pr b{display:inline;font-size:21px}

  .cat:hover{padding-inline:12px}
}

.rail-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rail-nav{display:flex;gap:10px}
.rail-nav button{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #ffffff40;background:transparent;color:var(--w);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:all .3s}

.rail{margin-top:40px;display:flex;gap:16px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding:0 max(20px,calc((100vw - 1240px)/2)) 10px;scroll-padding-inline:max(20px,calc((100vw - 1240px)/2));scrollbar-width:none;cursor:grab}
.rail::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.rail figure{flex:none;margin:0;width:clamp(260px,34vw,500px);aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;scroll-snap-align:start;background:var(--k2)}

.rev-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:clamp(24px,5vw,72px);align-items:end}

.rcard{margin:0;width:min(400px,84vw);background:var(--k2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 22px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}

.rst{display:flex;gap:2px}.rst svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:var(--y)}

.rota-lamps i::after{box-shadow:0 0 30px 12px #ffd40055}
.rota-road{background:#141414}
.rota-sign{filter:brightness(.45) saturate(.6)}
.rota-sign.lit{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 26px #ffd40066)}
.rota-sign.done{filter:brightness(.7)}
.rota.on .rota-panel{background:#111;border:1px solid #ffffff1f}
.rota-car::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:96%;top:40%;width:min(46vw,560px);height:150px;transform:translateY(-50%);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff6c8aa,#ffd40022 50%,transparent);clip-path:polygon(0 44%,100% 0,100% 100%,0 58%);mix-blend-mode:screen;pointer-events:none}
@media(max-width:820px){.rota-car::after{width:70vw;height:100px}}

.lead{color:var(--mut);font-size:clamp(16px,1.15vw,17.5px);max-width:58ch;margin:14px 0 0}
/* ===== cabeçalho ===== */
.progress{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:3px;z-index:80;pointer-events:none}
.progress i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--y);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(var(--p,0))}
.top{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;z-index:60;background:#070707ee;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.top.solid{background:#070707e6;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom-color:var(--line)}
.top .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;height:78px}
.logo{display:flex;flex:none;text-decoration:none}
.logo svg{height:42px;width:auto}
.nav{display:flex;gap:30px;margin-left:auto;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.nav a{text-decoration:none;color:#E9E5D5;transition:color .2s}
.nav a:hover{color:var(--y)}
.top .btn{min-height:46px;padding:0 20px}
@media(max-width:960px){.nav{display:none}.top .btn{margin-left:auto}}
@media(max-width:520px){.top .wrap{height:66px}.logo svg{height:34px}.top .btn{min-height:42px;padding:0 15px;font-size:14px}}

/* ===== hero: noite na Penha, o carro amarelo aceso ===== */
.hero{position:relative;background:var(--k);color:#fff;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;min-height:100svh;padding-top:78px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.hero-media{position:absolute;inset:0 0 0 auto;width:min(62%,980px);z-index:-1}
.hero-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:62% 55%;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,#000 34%),linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 22%);-webkit-mask-composite:source-in;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,#000 34%),linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 22%);mask-composite:intersect;filter:saturate(1.08) contrast(1.05)}
.hero-dia{position:absolute;right:max(4vw,40px);top:50%;width:min(44vw,640px);aspect-ratio:1;translate:0 -50%;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none}
.hero-dia i{position:absolute;inset:14%;border:2px solid #FFD40055;border-radius:6%;transform:rotate(calc(45deg + var(--spin,0deg)))}
.hero-dia i+i{inset:24%;border-color:#FFD40026}
.hero>.wrap{position:relative;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(32px,6vh,72px) 0 clamp(28px,5vh,56px)}
.hero-copy{max-width:640px}
.status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;background:#ffffff12;border:1px solid #ffffff26;color:#fff;border-radius:99px;padding:7px 15px 7px 11px;margin:0 0 24px}
.status i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#999}
.status.open i{background:#3BE37A;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #3be37a88;animation:pulse 2s infinite}
.status.closed i{background:#FF5A4E}
@keyframes pulse{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px #3be37a00}}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(38px,4.8vw,70px);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-stretch:115%;color:#fff}
.hero h1 .row{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding:.1em 0 .12em;margin:-.1em 0 -.12em}
.hero h1 .row>span{display:inline-block}
.hero h1 .hl{color:var(--y)}
.hero .sub{font-size:clamp(16px,1.25vw,18px);max-width:46ch;margin:22px 0 28px;color:#D8D3BA}
.hero .ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.hero .btn-y{background:var(--y);color:var(--k)}
.hero .btn-y:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 16px 30px -14px #ffd40099}
.plate{position:absolute;right:clamp(16px,6vw,110px);bottom:clamp(120px,24vh,230px);width:200px;background:#fff;color:var(--k);border:3px solid #111;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 40px -20px #000;transform:rotate(-5deg)}
.plate .bar{background:#1B3FA6;color:#fff;font:800 10px/1 var(--disp);letter-spacing:.12em;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:5px 9px}
.plate .bar svg{height:9px;width:auto}
.plate b{display:block;text-align:center;font:900 40px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:85%;letter-spacing:.02em;padding:7px 6px 1px}
.plate small{display:block;text-align:center;font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;padding:0 8px 8px}
.proof{position:relative;border-top:1px solid #ffffff1f;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#0B0B0B,#0b0b0bcc)}
.proof .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 34px;align-items:center;padding:18px 0;flex:none}
.proof span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;color:#E6E1C8}
.proof b{color:var(--y)}
.proof span::before{content:"";width:9px;height:9px;background:var(--y);transform:rotate(45deg);flex:none}
.lane{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-2px;height:3px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--y) 0 36px,transparent 36px 72px);animation:lane 1.6s linear infinite;opacity:.9}
@keyframes lane{to{background-position:-72px 0}}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero{min-height:0}
  .hero-media{position:relative;inset:auto;width:100%;height:52vw;max-height:420px;min-height:240px;z-index:0}
  .hero-media img{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 40%);mask-image:linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 40%);mask-composite:add;-webkit-mask-composite:source-over}
  .hero-dia{display:none}
  .hero>.wrap{padding-top:0;margin-top:-56px;z-index:1}
  .plate{right:16px;top:calc(min(52vw,420px) - 120px);bottom:auto;width:150px}
  .plate b{font-size:30px}
  .proof .wrap{gap:10px 20px}
}
.hero h1.t{font-size:clamp(38px,4.8vw,70px);line-height:.92}
@media(max-width:900px){.hero{padding-top:66px}.hero h1.t{font-size:clamp(32px,9.4vw,44px)}.hero .ctas .btn{flex:1 1 100%}.proof{margin-top:28px}}

/* ===== manifesto que acende com a rolagem ===== */
.mani{padding:clamp(90px,13vw,170px) 0}
.mani .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,.85fr);gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px);align-items:center}
.mani p{font:800 clamp(24px,2.7vw,40px)/1.22 var(--disp);font-stretch:106%;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0}
.mani figure{margin:0;position:relative;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/5;background:var(--k2)}
.mani figure img{width:100%;height:118%;object-fit:cover;object-position:62% 50%;transform:translateY(var(--my,-6%))}
.mani figcaption{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#070707d9;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;font-size:14px;color:#E6E1C8}
.mani figcaption b{color:var(--y);font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:80%}
@media(max-width:860px){.mani .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mani figure{aspect-ratio:4/3.4}}
.mani p span{color:#ffffff24;transition:color .5s}
.mani p span.on{color:var(--w)}
.mani p span.hl.on{color:var(--y)}
.mani .who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:36px;color:var(--mut);font-size:15px}
.mani .who img{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid var(--y)}

/* ===== lei ===== */
.law{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.85fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);gap:clamp(30px,6vw,96px);align-items:start}
.lrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:baseline;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.lrow.h{padding:0 0 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff40;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut)}
.lrow .was{color:#76725F;text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-thickness:1.5px}
.lrow .now{font:900 19px/1.1 var(--disp);font-stretch:112%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--y);text-align:right}
.law .note{margin-top:22px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
@media(max-width:860px){.law{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:560px){.lrow{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;row-gap:4px}.lrow>span:first-child{grid-column:1/-1;font-weight:600}.lrow.h{display:none}}

/* ===== pacotes: bilhetes ===== */
.pk-grid{margin-top:48px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}
.tk{position:relative;background:var(--k2);border-radius:22px;padding:28px 26px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .5s var(--ease),background .3s}
.tk .perf{position:relative;display:block;margin:0 -26px 24px;border-top:2px dashed #ffffff22}
.tk .perf::before,.tk .perf::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:-14px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--k1)}
.tk .perf::before{left:-13px}.tk .perf::after{right:-13px}
.tk:hover{transform:translateY(-6px)}
.tk.hot{background:var(--y);color:var(--k)}
.tk.hot .perf{border-color:#0000002a}
.tk .tag{position:absolute;top:22px;right:22px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--k);color:var(--y)}
.tk h3{font:900 21px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:120%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}
.tk .for{font-size:14.5px;margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--mut)}
.tk.hot .for{color:#3d3a28}
.tk .price{margin:22px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;font:900 clamp(48px,4.4vw,64px)/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:78%}
.tk .price small{font-size:.3em;font-stretch:100%;margin-top:.45em}
.tk .per{font-size:14px;margin:6px 0 24px;color:var(--mut)}
.tk.hot .per{color:#3d3a28}
.tk ul{list-style:none;margin:0 0 26px;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px;font-size:15px}
.tk li{display:flex;gap:10px}
.tk li svg{width:17px;height:17px;flex:none;margin-top:4px;fill:none;stroke:var(--y);stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.tk.hot li svg{stroke:var(--k)}
.tk .btn{margin-top:auto;width:100%}
.tk.hot .btn-o{border-color:var(--k);color:var(--k)}
.fine{margin-top:22px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)}
.fine a{color:var(--y)}
.roll{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;height:1.1em;line-height:1.1em;vertical-align:top}
.roll>span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform 1.6s var(--ease)}
.roll i{font-style:normal;height:1.1em;line-height:1.1em;display:block}
@media(max-width:960px){.pk-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:520px}}

/* ===== categorias ===== */
.cats{margin-top:44px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff40}
.cat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr) auto 44px;gap:22px;align-items:center;padding:22px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;position:relative;isolation:isolate;transition:padding .5s var(--ease),color .3s}
.cat::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--y);z-index:-1;transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom;transition:transform .5s var(--ease);border-radius:14px}
.cat:hover{color:var(--k);padding-inline:22px}
.cat:hover::before{transform:scaleY(1)}
.cat .ic{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:16px;border:1.5px solid #ffffff2a;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:border-color .3s}
.cat .ic svg{width:32px;height:32px;fill:none;stroke:var(--y);stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:stroke .3s}
.cat:hover .ic{border-color:#00000030}.cat:hover .ic svg{stroke:var(--k)}
.cat h3{font:900 clamp(19px,1.8vw,24px)/1.05 var(--disp);font-stretch:118%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}
.cat p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut);transition:color .3s}
.cat:hover p{color:#3d3a28}
.cat .pr{text-align:right;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap}
.cat:hover .pr{color:#3d3a28}
.cat .pr b{display:block;font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:82%;color:var(--w)}
.cat:hover .pr b{color:var(--k)}
.cat .go svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
.cat:hover .go svg{transform:translateX(6px)}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .cat{grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr);row-gap:10px;padding:20px 4px}
  .cat .ic{width:52px;height:52px;grid-row:span 2;align-self:start}.cat .ic svg{width:26px;height:26px}
  .cat .pr{text-align:left;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline}.cat .pr b{display:inline;font-size:21px}
  .cat .go{display:none}
  .cat:hover{padding-inline:12px}
}

/* ===== frota: trilho horizontal ===== */
.rail-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rail-nav{display:flex;gap:10px}
.rail-nav button{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #ffffff40;background:transparent;color:var(--w);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:all .3s}
.rail-nav button:hover{background:var(--y);color:var(--k);border-color:var(--y)}
.rail-nav svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.rail{margin-top:40px;display:flex;gap:16px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding:0 max(20px,calc((100vw - 1240px)/2)) 10px;scroll-padding-inline:max(20px,calc((100vw - 1240px)/2));scrollbar-width:none;cursor:grab}
.rail::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.rail figure{flex:none;margin:0;width:clamp(260px,34vw,500px);aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;scroll-snap-align:start;background:var(--k2)}
.rail figure.wide{width:clamp(300px,52vw,760px);aspect-ratio:16/10}
.rail img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
.rail figure:hover img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.rail figcaption{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:16px;right:16px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700}
.rail figcaption span{background:#070707cc;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);padding:7px 12px;border-radius:99px}
@media(max-width:700px){.rail figure{width:78vw}.rail figure.wide{width:86vw}.rail-nav{display:none}}

/* ===== avaliações passando ===== */
.rev-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:clamp(24px,5vw,72px);align-items:end}
.score{margin:0;font:900 clamp(84px,9vw,132px)/.82 var(--disp);font-stretch:76%;color:var(--y)}
.score small{display:block;font:600 14px/1.4 var(--disp);font-stretch:100%;color:var(--mut);margin-top:12px}
.stars5{display:flex;gap:3px;margin-top:12px}.stars5 svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:var(--y)}
.marq{margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,60px);display:grid;gap:16px;overflow:hidden}
.mrow{display:flex;width:max-content}
.mtrack{display:flex;gap:16px;padding-right:16px;animation:marq 70s linear infinite}
.rev2 .mtrack{animation-duration:82s;animation-direction:reverse}
@keyframes marq{to{transform:translateX(-100%)}}
.rcard{margin:0;width:min(400px,84vw);background:var(--k2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 22px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.rtop{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.av{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--y);color:var(--k);display:grid;place-items:center;font:900 17px/1 var(--disp);font-style:italic}
.rtop b{display:block;font-size:15px}
.rtop small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.rst{display:flex;gap:2px}.rst svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:var(--y)}
.rcard blockquote{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:#DCD7C3}
@media(max-width:760px){.rev-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:start}}

/* ===== endereço ===== */
.visit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.1fr);gap:clamp(24px,4vw,56px);margin-top:44px}
.addr{font:900 clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px)/1.1 var(--disp);font-stretch:110%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}
.near{color:var(--mut);margin:10px 0 26px;font-size:15px}
.hours{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:15.5px;margin:0 0 28px}
.hours td{padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.hours td:last-child{text-align:right;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hours tr.today td{color:var(--y)}
.hours tr.today td:first-child::after{content:"  · hoje";color:var(--mut);font-weight:400}
.go{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.btn-waze{background:#33CCFF;color:#04202d}
.btn-waze:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.map{border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;min-height:440px;background:var(--k2);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.map iframe{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:440px;border:0;filter:invert(.9) hue-rotate(180deg) saturate(.6) contrast(.95)}
@media(max-width:860px){.visit{grid-template-columns:1fr}.map,.map iframe{min-height:320px}.go .btn{flex:1 1 calc(50% - 10px)}.go .btn-wa{flex-basis:100%}}

/* ===== bairros + faq ===== */
.hoods{margin-top:30px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.hoods span{border:1px solid #ffffff2e;border-radius:99px;padding:10px 18px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.hoods span:first-child{background:var(--y);color:var(--k);border-color:var(--y)}
.faq{margin-top:40px;max-width:920px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff40}
.faq details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.faq summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:center;padding:20px 0;font:700 clamp(16.5px,1.4vw,18.5px)/1.35 var(--disp)}
.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq summary i{flex:none;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #ffffff40;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .45s var(--ease),background .3s,border-color .3s}
.faq summary i svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:none;stroke:var(--y);stroke-width:2.6;stroke-linecap:round}
.faq details[open] summary i{transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--y);border-color:var(--y)}
.faq details[open] summary i svg{stroke:var(--k)}
.faq details p{margin:0 0 22px;max-width:70ch;color:var(--mut)}
.net{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:36px}
.net>*{border:1px solid #ffffff26;border-radius:20px;padding:24px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--mut);font-size:15px}
.net b{display:block;color:var(--w);font:900 20px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:118%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px}
.net .here{border-color:var(--y)}
.net a:hover{border-color:var(--y)}
@media(max-width:700px){.net{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ===== final ===== */
.final{background:var(--y);color:var(--k);overflow:hidden;padding:clamp(90px,12vw,160px) 0}
.final .t{font-size:clamp(46px,9vw,140px);line-height:.86}
.final p{font-size:18px;margin:22px 0 30px;max-width:44ch}
.final .btn-k:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 18px 30px -14px #0008}
.final .big-e{position:absolute;right:-6vw;top:50%;width:min(46vw,620px);aspect-ratio:1;translate:0 -50%;pointer-events:none}
.final .big-e i{position:absolute;inset:12%;border:3px solid #00000022;border-radius:7%;transform:rotate(calc(45deg + var(--spin,0deg)))}
.final .big-e i+i{inset:24%;border-color:#00000014}
footer{background:var(--k);color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;padding:50px 0 120px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}
footer .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:28px;justify-content:space-between}

/* rota à noite (versão preta) */

.rota-city i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#11161c 64%,transparent 0) 0 0/14px 100%,linear-gradient(#11161c 60%,transparent 0) 0 8px/100% 18px,#3a3010!important;border-top:1px solid #1d2630}

.plate{position:absolute;right:clamp(16px,6vw,110px);bottom:clamp(120px,24vh,230px);width:200px;background:#fff;color:var(--k);border:3px solid #111;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 40px -20px #000;transform:rotate(-5deg)}

.cat:hover::before{transform:scaleY(1)}
.cat .ic{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:16px;border:1.5px solid #ffffff2a;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:border-color .3s}

.rail{margin-top:40px;display:flex;gap:16px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding:0 max(20px,calc((100vw - 1240px)/2)) 10px;scroll-padding-inline:max(20px,calc((100vw - 1240px)/2));scrollbar-width:none;cursor:grab}

.rota.on{height:560vh}

.rota-city{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:calc(var(--road) + 26px);height:42%;width:400%;will-change:transform}
.rota-city i{position:absolute;bottom:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#8FC4DD 64%,transparent 0) 0 0/14px 100%,linear-gradient(#8FC4DD 60%,transparent 0) 0 8px/100% 18px,#DDF0FA}
.rota-city i:nth-child(3n){background:linear-gradient(90deg,#A9D3E7 66%,transparent 0) 0 0/12px 100%,linear-gradient(#A9D3E7 62%,transparent 0) 0 6px/100% 20px,#EEF8FD}
.rota-world{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:var(--road);height:58%;width:calc(var(--sw) * 7);will-change:transform;z-index:1}
.rota-lamps{position:absolute;inset:0}
.rota-lamps i{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:6px;height:52%;background:#3A3A3A;border-radius:3px}
.rota-lamps i::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:44px;height:6px;background:#3A3A3A;border-radius:3px}
.rota-lamps i::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:4px;left:34px;width:16px;height:8px;background:var(--y);border-radius:0 0 8px 8px}
.rota-sign{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:160px;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;transition:transform .5s var(--ease),filter .5s;filter:saturate(.35) brightness(.92);transform:scale(.9);transform-origin:bottom center}
.rota-dia{position:relative;width:104px;height:104px;margin-bottom:24px;transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--y);border:6px solid var(--k);outline:4px solid var(--y);border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 18px 22px -14px #0007}
.rota-dia svg{width:46px;height:46px;transform:rotate(-45deg);fill:none;stroke:var(--k);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.rota-plate{font:800 14px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:115%;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--k);color:var(--y);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:4px;white-space:nowrap}
.rota-pole{width:8px;flex:1 1 auto;max-height:44%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6c6c6c,#cfcfcf 50%,#5a5a5a)}
.rota-sign.lit{filter:none;transform:scale(1) translateY(-6px)}
.rota-sign.done{filter:saturate(.8);transform:scale(.94)}
.rota-finish{position:absolute;bottom:calc(var(--road) * -.5);height:calc(80% + var(--road) * .5);border-left:10px solid var(--k);border-right:10px solid var(--k);filter:saturate(.4);transition:filter .5s}
.rota-finish span{position:absolute;top:0;left:-10px;right:-10px;height:60px;background:conic-gradient(var(--y) 25%,var(--k) 0 50%,var(--y) 0 75%,var(--k) 0) 0 0/24px 24px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.rota-finish span::after{content:"CNH na mão";font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:120%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--b);color:#fff;padding:6px 16px;border-radius:6px}
.rota-finish.lit{filter:none}
.rota-road{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:var(--road);background:#2E2E2E;z-index:2}
.rota-road::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-12px;height:12px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--y) 0 34px,var(--k) 34px 68px)}
.rota-lane{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;height:7px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--y) 0 64px,transparent 64px 116px);will-change:background-position}
.rota-car{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:clamp(16px,15vw,420px);bottom:calc(var(--road) * .28);width:clamp(190px,21vw,290px)}
.rota-car svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
.rota.moving .rota-car svg{animation:bump .3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}

.wheel{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.rota.on .rota-panel{display:block;position:absolute;z-index:6;right:clamp(16px,5vw,80px);top:calc(var(--hdr,76px) + clamp(18px,4vh,40px));width:min(400px,calc(100% - 32px));background:var(--k);color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:0 30px 50px -28px #000c}
.rp-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;color:#D9D4B4}
.rp-top .km{color:var(--y)}

.rp-text{margin:0;font-size:15.5px;min-height:3em}
.rp-bars{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:16px}
.rp-bars i{flex:1;height:6px;border-radius:9px;background:#ffffff26;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.rp-bars i b{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--y);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(0)}
.rp-cta{display:none!important;margin-top:16px}
.rota.end .rp-cta{display:inline-flex!important}

  .rota-sign{width:120px}.rota-dia{width:72px;height:72px;margin-bottom:16px}.rota-dia svg{width:32px;height:32px}.rota-plate{font-size:12px;padding:6px 9px}
  .rota-car{left:10px;width:160px;bottom:18px}

}


/* rota à noite (versão preta) */
.rota{background:var(--k)}
.rota-list li{background:var(--k2);color:var(--w)}
.rota-list h3{color:var(--y)}
.rota.on .rota-pin{background:radial-gradient(90% 60% at 70% 10%,#1c2530 0%,#0b0f14 45%,#070707 100%)}
.rota-head .lead{color:var(--mut)}
.rota-city i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#11161c 64%,transparent 0) 0 0/14px 100%,linear-gradient(#11161c 60%,transparent 0) 0 8px/100% 18px,#3a3010!important;border-top:1px solid #1d2630}
.rota-city i:nth-child(3n){background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0d1117 70%,transparent 0) 0 0/12px 100%,linear-gradient(#0d1117 64%,transparent 0) 0 6px/100% 20px,#2b2a20!important}
.rota-lamps i,.rota-lamps i::before{background:#2a2a2a}
.rota-lamps i::after{box-shadow:0 0 30px 12px #ffd40055}
.rota-road{background:#141414}
.rota-sign{filter:brightness(.45) saturate(.6)}
.rota-sign.lit{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 26px #ffd40066)}
.rota-sign.done{filter:brightness(.7)}
.rota.on .rota-panel{background:#111;border:1px solid #ffffff1f}
.rota-car::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:96%;top:40%;width:min(46vw,560px);height:150px;transform:translateY(-50%);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff6c8aa,#ffd40022 50%,transparent);clip-path:polygon(0 44%,100% 0,100% 100%,0 58%);mix-blend-mode:screen;pointer-events:none}
@media(max-width:820px){.rota-car::after{width:70vw;height:100px}}

.lead{color:var(--mut);font-size:clamp(16px,1.15vw,17.5px);max-width:58ch;margin:14px 0 0}
/* ===== cabeçalho ===== */
.progress{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:3px;z-index:80;pointer-events:none}
.progress i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--y);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(var(--p,0))}
.top{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:0;z-index:60;background:#070707ee;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.top.solid{background:#070707e6;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom-color:var(--line)}
.top .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:28px;height:78px}
.logo{display:flex;flex:none;text-decoration:none}
.logo svg{height:42px;width:auto}
.nav{display:flex;gap:30px;margin-left:auto;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.nav a{text-decoration:none;color:#E9E5D5;transition:color .2s}
.nav a:hover{color:var(--y)}
.top .btn{min-height:46px;padding:0 20px}
@media(max-width:960px){.nav{display:none}.top .btn{margin-left:auto}}
@media(max-width:520px){.top .wrap{height:66px}.logo svg{height:34px}.top .btn{min-height:42px;padding:0 15px;font-size:14px}}

/* ===== hero: noite na Penha, o carro amarelo aceso ===== */
.hero{position:relative;background:var(--k);color:#fff;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;min-height:100svh;padding-top:78px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.hero-media{position:absolute;inset:0 0 0 auto;width:min(62%,980px);z-index:-1}
.hero-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:62% 55%;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,#000 34%),linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 22%);-webkit-mask-composite:source-in;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,#000 34%),linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 22%);mask-composite:intersect;filter:saturate(1.08) contrast(1.05)}
.hero-dia{position:absolute;right:max(4vw,40px);top:50%;width:min(44vw,640px);aspect-ratio:1;translate:0 -50%;z-index:-2;pointer-events:none}
.hero-dia i{position:absolute;inset:14%;border:2px solid #FFD40055;border-radius:6%;transform:rotate(calc(45deg + var(--spin,0deg)))}
.hero-dia i+i{inset:24%;border-color:#FFD40026}
.hero>.wrap{position:relative;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(32px,6vh,72px) 0 clamp(28px,5vh,56px)}
.hero-copy{max-width:640px}
.status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:700;font-size:14px;background:#ffffff12;border:1px solid #ffffff26;color:#fff;border-radius:99px;padding:7px 15px 7px 11px;margin:0 0 24px}
.status i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:50%;background:#999}
.status.open i{background:#3BE37A;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #3be37a88;animation:pulse 2s infinite}
.status.closed i{background:#FF5A4E}
@keyframes pulse{70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px #3be37a00}}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(38px,4.8vw,70px);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.01em;font-stretch:115%;color:#fff}
.hero h1 .row{display:block;overflow:hidden;padding:.1em 0 .12em;margin:-.1em 0 -.12em}
.hero h1 .row>span{display:inline-block}
.hero h1 .hl{color:var(--y)}
.hero .sub{font-size:clamp(16px,1.25vw,18px);max-width:46ch;margin:22px 0 28px;color:#D8D3BA}
.hero .ctas{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.hero .btn-y{background:var(--y);color:var(--k)}
.hero .btn-y:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 16px 30px -14px #ffd40099}
.plate{position:absolute;right:clamp(16px,6vw,110px);bottom:clamp(120px,24vh,230px);width:200px;background:#fff;color:var(--k);border:3px solid #111;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 40px -20px #000;transform:rotate(-5deg)}
.plate .bar{background:#1B3FA6;color:#fff;font:800 10px/1 var(--disp);letter-spacing:.12em;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:5px 9px}
.plate .bar svg{height:9px;width:auto}
.plate b{display:block;text-align:center;font:900 40px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:85%;letter-spacing:.02em;padding:7px 6px 1px}
.plate small{display:block;text-align:center;font-weight:700;font-size:11.5px;padding:0 8px 8px}
.proof{position:relative;border-top:1px solid #ffffff1f;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#0B0B0B,#0b0b0bcc)}
.proof .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 34px;align-items:center;padding:18px 0;flex:none}
.proof span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;color:#E6E1C8}
.proof b{color:var(--y)}
.proof span::before{content:"";width:9px;height:9px;background:var(--y);transform:rotate(45deg);flex:none}
.lane{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-2px;height:3px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--y) 0 36px,transparent 36px 72px);animation:lane 1.6s linear infinite;opacity:.9}
@keyframes lane{to{background-position:-72px 0}}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .hero{min-height:0}
  .hero-media{position:relative;inset:auto;width:100%;height:52vw;max-height:420px;min-height:240px;z-index:0}
  .hero-media img{-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 40%);mask-image:linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0,#000 40%);mask-composite:add;-webkit-mask-composite:source-over}
  .hero-dia{display:none}
  .hero>.wrap{padding-top:0;margin-top:-56px;z-index:1}
  .plate{right:16px;top:calc(min(52vw,420px) - 120px);bottom:auto;width:150px}
  .plate b{font-size:30px}
  .proof .wrap{gap:10px 20px}
}
.hero h1.t{font-size:clamp(38px,4.8vw,70px);line-height:.92}
@media(max-width:900px){.hero{padding-top:66px}.hero h1.t{font-size:clamp(32px,9.4vw,44px)}.hero .ctas .btn{flex:1 1 100%}.proof{margin-top:28px}}

/* ===== manifesto que acende com a rolagem ===== */
.mani{padding:clamp(90px,13vw,170px) 0}
.mani .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(0,.85fr);gap:clamp(32px,6vw,96px);align-items:center}
.mani p{font:800 clamp(24px,2.7vw,40px)/1.22 var(--disp);font-stretch:106%;letter-spacing:-.01em;margin:0}
.mani figure{margin:0;position:relative;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:4/5;background:var(--k2)}
.mani figure img{width:100%;height:118%;object-fit:cover;object-position:62% 50%;transform:translateY(var(--my,-6%))}
.mani figcaption{position:absolute;left:16px;right:16px;bottom:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:#070707d9;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;font-size:14px;color:#E6E1C8}
.mani figcaption b{color:var(--y);font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:80%}
@media(max-width:860px){.mani .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mani figure{aspect-ratio:4/3.4}}
.mani p span{color:#ffffff24;transition:color .5s}
.mani p span.on{color:var(--w)}
.mani p span.hl.on{color:var(--y)}
.mani .who{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:36px;color:var(--mut);font-size:15px}
.mani .who img{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid var(--y)}

/* ===== lei ===== */
.law{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.85fr) minmax(0,1.15fr);gap:clamp(30px,6vw,96px);align-items:start}
.lrow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;align-items:baseline;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.lrow.h{padding:0 0 12px;border-bottom:1px solid #ffffff40;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--mut)}
.lrow .was{color:#76725F;text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-thickness:1.5px}
.lrow .now{font:900 19px/1.1 var(--disp);font-stretch:112%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--y);text-align:right}
.law .note{margin-top:22px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut)}
@media(max-width:860px){.law{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:560px){.lrow{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;row-gap:4px}.lrow>span:first-child{grid-column:1/-1;font-weight:600}.lrow.h{display:none}}

/* ===== pacotes: bilhetes ===== */
.pk-grid{margin-top:48px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}
.tk{position:relative;background:var(--k2);border-radius:22px;padding:28px 26px 26px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .5s var(--ease),background .3s}
.tk .perf{position:relative;display:block;margin:0 -26px 24px;border-top:2px dashed #ffffff22}
.tk .perf::before,.tk .perf::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:-14px;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--k1)}
.tk .perf::before{left:-13px}.tk .perf::after{right:-13px}
.tk:hover{transform:translateY(-6px)}
.tk.hot{background:var(--y);color:var(--k)}
.tk.hot .perf{border-color:#0000002a}
.tk .tag{position:absolute;top:22px;right:22px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--k);color:var(--y)}
.tk h3{font:900 21px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:120%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}
.tk .for{font-size:14.5px;margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--mut)}
.tk.hot .for{color:#3d3a28}
.tk .price{margin:22px 0 0;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;font:900 clamp(48px,4.4vw,64px)/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:78%}
.tk .price small{font-size:.3em;font-stretch:100%;margin-top:.45em}
.tk .per{font-size:14px;margin:6px 0 24px;color:var(--mut)}
.tk.hot .per{color:#3d3a28}
.tk ul{list-style:none;margin:0 0 26px;padding:0;display:grid;gap:10px;font-size:15px}
.tk li{display:flex;gap:10px}
.tk li svg{width:17px;height:17px;flex:none;margin-top:4px;fill:none;stroke:var(--y);stroke-width:3;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.tk.hot li svg{stroke:var(--k)}
.tk .btn{margin-top:auto;width:100%}
.tk.hot .btn-o{border-color:var(--k);color:var(--k)}
.fine{margin-top:22px;font-size:14px;color:var(--mut)}
.fine a{color:var(--y)}
.roll{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;height:1.1em;line-height:1.1em;vertical-align:top}
.roll>span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:transform 1.6s var(--ease)}
.roll i{font-style:normal;height:1.1em;line-height:1.1em;display:block}
@media(max-width:960px){.pk-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:520px}}

/* ===== categorias ===== */
.cats{margin-top:44px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff40}
.cat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr) auto 44px;gap:22px;align-items:center;padding:22px 8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;position:relative;isolation:isolate;transition:padding .5s var(--ease),color .3s}
.cat::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--y);z-index:-1;transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:bottom;transition:transform .5s var(--ease);border-radius:14px}
.cat:hover{color:var(--k);padding-inline:22px}
.cat:hover::before{transform:scaleY(1)}
.cat .ic{width:60px;height:60px;border-radius:16px;border:1.5px solid #ffffff2a;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:border-color .3s}
.cat .ic svg{width:32px;height:32px;fill:none;stroke:var(--y);stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:stroke .3s}
.cat:hover .ic{border-color:#00000030}.cat:hover .ic svg{stroke:var(--k)}
.cat h3{font:900 clamp(19px,1.8vw,24px)/1.05 var(--disp);font-stretch:118%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}
.cat p{margin:5px 0 0;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--mut);transition:color .3s}
.cat:hover p{color:#3d3a28}
.cat .pr{text-align:right;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);white-space:nowrap}
.cat:hover .pr{color:#3d3a28}
.cat .pr b{display:block;font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:82%;color:var(--w)}
.cat:hover .pr b{color:var(--k)}
.cat .go svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
.cat:hover .go svg{transform:translateX(6px)}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .cat{grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr);row-gap:10px;padding:20px 4px}
  .cat .ic{width:52px;height:52px;grid-row:span 2;align-self:start}.cat .ic svg{width:26px;height:26px}
  .cat .pr{text-align:left;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:baseline}.cat .pr b{display:inline;font-size:21px}
  .cat .go{display:none}
  .cat:hover{padding-inline:12px}
}

/* ===== frota: trilho horizontal ===== */
.rail-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.rail-nav{display:flex;gap:10px}
.rail-nav button{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #ffffff40;background:transparent;color:var(--w);cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:all .3s}
.rail-nav button:hover{background:var(--y);color:var(--k);border-color:var(--y)}
.rail-nav svg{width:20px;height:20px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.rail{margin-top:40px;display:flex;gap:16px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding:0 max(20px,calc((100vw - 1240px)/2)) 10px;scroll-padding-inline:max(20px,calc((100vw - 1240px)/2));scrollbar-width:none;cursor:grab}
.rail::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.rail figure{flex:none;margin:0;width:clamp(260px,34vw,500px);aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;position:relative;scroll-snap-align:start;background:var(--k2)}
.rail figure.wide{width:clamp(300px,52vw,760px);aspect-ratio:16/10}
.rail img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
.rail figure:hover img{transform:scale(1.05)}
.rail figcaption{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:16px;right:16px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700}
.rail figcaption span{background:#070707cc;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);padding:7px 12px;border-radius:99px}
@media(max-width:700px){.rail figure{width:78vw}.rail figure.wide{width:86vw}.rail-nav{display:none}}

/* ===== avaliações passando ===== */
.rev-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:clamp(24px,5vw,72px);align-items:end}
.score{margin:0;font:900 clamp(84px,9vw,132px)/.82 var(--disp);font-stretch:76%;color:var(--y)}
.score small{display:block;font:600 14px/1.4 var(--disp);font-stretch:100%;color:var(--mut);margin-top:12px}
.stars5{display:flex;gap:3px;margin-top:12px}.stars5 svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:var(--y)}
.marq{margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,60px);display:grid;gap:16px;overflow:hidden}
.mrow{display:flex;width:max-content}
.mtrack{display:flex;gap:16px;padding-right:16px;animation:marq 70s linear infinite}
.rev2 .mtrack{animation-duration:82s;animation-direction:reverse}
@keyframes marq{to{transform:translateX(-100%)}}
.rcard{margin:0;width:min(400px,84vw);background:var(--k2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 22px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.rtop{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.av{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--y);color:var(--k);display:grid;place-items:center;font:900 17px/1 var(--disp);font-style:italic}
.rtop b{display:block;font-size:15px}
.rtop small{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut)}
.rst{display:flex;gap:2px}.rst svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:var(--y)}
.rcard blockquote{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6;color:#DCD7C3}
@media(max-width:760px){.rev-top{grid-template-columns:1fr;align-items:start}}

/* ===== endereço ===== */
.visit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.1fr);gap:clamp(24px,4vw,56px);margin-top:44px}
.addr{font:900 clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px)/1.1 var(--disp);font-stretch:110%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin:0}
.near{color:var(--mut);margin:10px 0 26px;font-size:15px}
.hours{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:15.5px;margin:0 0 28px}
.hours td{padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.hours td:last-child{text-align:right;font-weight:600;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.hours tr.today td{color:var(--y)}
.hours tr.today td:first-child::after{content:"  · hoje";color:var(--mut);font-weight:400}
.go{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.btn-waze{background:#33CCFF;color:#04202d}
.btn-waze:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.map{border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;min-height:440px;background:var(--k2);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.map iframe{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:440px;border:0;filter:invert(.9) hue-rotate(180deg) saturate(.6) contrast(.95)}
@media(max-width:860px){.visit{grid-template-columns:1fr}.map,.map iframe{min-height:320px}.go .btn{flex:1 1 calc(50% - 10px)}.go .btn-wa{flex-basis:100%}}

/* ===== bairros + faq ===== */
.hoods{margin-top:30px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.hoods span{border:1px solid #ffffff2e;border-radius:99px;padding:10px 18px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600}
.hoods span:first-child{background:var(--y);color:var(--k);border-color:var(--y)}
.faq{margin-top:40px;max-width:920px;border-top:1px solid #ffffff40}
.faq details{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.faq summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;align-items:center;padding:20px 0;font:700 clamp(16.5px,1.4vw,18.5px)/1.35 var(--disp)}
.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq summary i{flex:none;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid #ffffff40;display:grid;place-items:center;transition:transform .45s var(--ease),background .3s,border-color .3s}
.faq summary i svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:none;stroke:var(--y);stroke-width:2.6;stroke-linecap:round}
.faq details[open] summary i{transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--y);border-color:var(--y)}
.faq details[open] summary i svg{stroke:var(--k)}
.faq details p{margin:0 0 22px;max-width:70ch;color:var(--mut)}
.net{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:36px}
.net>*{border:1px solid #ffffff26;border-radius:20px;padding:24px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--mut);font-size:15px}
.net b{display:block;color:var(--w);font:900 20px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:118%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px}
.net .here{border-color:var(--y)}
.net a:hover{border-color:var(--y)}

.rota-city{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:calc(var(--road) + 26px);height:42%;width:400%;will-change:transform}

.rota-city i:nth-child(3n){background:linear-gradient(90deg,#A9D3E7 66%,transparent 0) 0 0/12px 100%,linear-gradient(#A9D3E7 62%,transparent 0) 0 6px/100% 20px,#EEF8FD}
.rota-world{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:var(--road);height:58%;width:calc(var(--sw) * 7);will-change:transform;z-index:1}
.rota-lamps{position:absolute;inset:0}
.rota-lamps i{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:6px;height:52%;background:#3A3A3A;border-radius:3px}
.rota-lamps i::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:44px;height:6px;background:#3A3A3A;border-radius:3px}
.rota-lamps i::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:4px;left:34px;width:16px;height:8px;background:var(--y);border-radius:0 0 8px 8px}
.rota-sign{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:160px;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;transition:transform .5s var(--ease),filter .5s;filter:saturate(.35) brightness(.92);transform:scale(.9);transform-origin:bottom center}
.rota-dia{position:relative;width:104px;height:104px;margin-bottom:24px;transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--y);border:6px solid var(--k);outline:4px solid var(--y);border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 18px 22px -14px #0007}
.rota-dia svg{width:46px;height:46px;transform:rotate(-45deg);fill:none;stroke:var(--k);stroke-width:2.2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.rota-plate{font:800 14px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:115%;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--k);color:var(--y);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:6px;margin-bottom:4px;white-space:nowrap}
.rota-pole{width:8px;flex:1 1 auto;max-height:44%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6c6c6c,#cfcfcf 50%,#5a5a5a)}
.rota-sign.lit{filter:none;transform:scale(1) translateY(-6px)}
.rota-sign.done{filter:saturate(.8);transform:scale(.94)}
.rota-finish{position:absolute;bottom:calc(var(--road) * -.5);height:calc(80% + var(--road) * .5);border-left:10px solid var(--k);border-right:10px solid var(--k);filter:saturate(.4);transition:filter .5s}
.rota-finish span{position:absolute;top:0;left:-10px;right:-10px;height:60px;background:conic-gradient(var(--y) 25%,var(--k) 0 50%,var(--y) 0 75%,var(--k) 0) 0 0/24px 24px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.rota-finish span::after{content:"CNH na mão";font:900 26px/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:120%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;background:var(--b);color:#fff;padding:6px 16px;border-radius:6px}
.rota-finish.lit{filter:none}
.rota-road{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:var(--road);background:#2E2E2E;z-index:2}
.rota-road::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-12px;height:12px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--y) 0 34px,var(--k) 34px 68px)}
.rota-lane{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;height:7px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,var(--y) 0 64px,transparent 64px 116px);will-change:background-position}
.rota-car{position:absolute;z-index:4;left:clamp(16px,15vw,420px);bottom:calc(var(--road) * .28);width:clamp(190px,21vw,290px)}
.rota-car svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 14px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
.rota.moving .rota-car svg{animation:bump .3s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes bump{to{transform:translateY(-1.5px)}}
.wheel{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:center}
.rota.on .rota-panel{display:block;position:absolute;z-index:6;right:clamp(16px,5vw,80px);top:calc(var(--hdr,76px) + clamp(18px,4vh,40px));width:min(400px,calc(100% - 32px));background:var(--k);color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:22px 24px;box-shadow:0 30px 50px -28px #000c}
.rp-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:700;font-size:13.5px;color:#D9D4B4}
.rp-top .km{color:var(--y)}
.rp-title{font:900 clamp(26px,2.6vw,36px)/1 var(--disp);font-stretch:125%;font-style:italic;text-transform:uppercase;margin:12px 0 8px;color:var(--y)}
.rp-text{margin:0;font-size:15.5px;min-height:3em}
.rp-bars{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:16px}
.rp-bars i{flex:1;height:6px;border-radius:9px;background:#ffffff26;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.rp-bars i b{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--y);transform-origin:left;transform:scaleX(0)}
.rp-cta{display:none!important;margin-top:16px}
.rota.end .rp-cta{display:inline-flex!important}
.swap{animation:swap .45s var(--ease)}
@keyframes swap{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);filter:blur(4px)}}
@media(max-width:820px){
  .rota.on{height:520vh}
  .rota.on .rota-scene{--sw:88vw;--road:96px}
  .rota.on .rota-head{padding-top:calc(var(--hdr,64px) + 14px)}
  .rota.on .rota-head h2{font-size:30px}
  .rota.on .rota-head .lead{display:none}
  .rota.on .rota-panel{left:16px;right:16px;width:auto;top:auto;bottom:calc(96px + 30vh + var(--dock,0px));padding:16px 18px}
  .rp-title{font-size:28px}.rp-text{font-size:14.5px;min-height:0}

  .rota-world{height:28vh}
  .rota-sign{width:120px}.rota-dia{width:72px;height:72px;margin-bottom:16px}.rota-dia svg{width:32px;height:32px}.rota-plate{font-size:12px;padding:6px 9px}
  .rota-car{left:10px;width:160px;bottom:18px}
  .rota-city{height:26%}
}


/* rota à noite (versão preta) */
.rota{background:var(--k)}
.rota-list li{background:var(--k2);color:var(--w)}
.rota-list h3{color:var(--y)}
.rota.on .rota-pin{background:radial-gradient(90% 60% at 70% 10%,#1c2530 0%,#0b0f14 45%,#070707 100%)}
.rota-head .lead{color:var(--mut)}
.rota-city i{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#11161c 64%,transparent 0) 0 0/14px 100%,linear-gradient(#11161c 60%,transparent 0) 0 8px/100% 18px,#3a3010!important;border-top:1px solid #1d2630}
.rota-city i:nth-child(3n){background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0d1117 70%,transparent 0) 0 0/12px 100%,linear-gradient(#0d1117 64%,transparent 0) 0 6px/100% 20px,#2b2a20!important}
.rota-lamps i,.rota-lamps i::before{background:#2a2a2a}
.rota-lamps i::after{box-shadow:0 0 30px 12px #ffd40055}
.rota-road{background:#141414}
.rota-sign{filter:brightness(.45) saturate(.6)}
.rota-sign.lit{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 26px #ffd40066)}
.rota-sign.done{filter:brightness(.7)}
.rota.on .rota-panel{background:#111;border:1px solid #ffffff1f}
.rota-car::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:96%;top:40%;width:min(46vw,560px);height:150px;transform:translateY(-50%);background:linear-gradient(90deg,#fff6c8aa,#ffd40022 50%,transparent);clip-path:polygon(0 44%,100% 0,100% 100%,0 58%);mix-blend-mode:screen;pointer-events:none}
